meta.name: Dravintel — SAI Digital-inspired Navy & Lime DNA
meta.description: Visual language extracted from sai-digital.com (Next.js build: public CSS tokens, GSAP/ScrollTrigger + Three.js usage, desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 captures, deterministic colour measurement) and applied to Dravintel's own content, logo, imagery, videos and functionality. Client-specified palette replaces the reference's black/teal: background #00182e, secondary #acec00. No text, assets or code copied.

color.palette_type: dark monochrome navy + single neon accent

primary.role: Page canvas (client brand). Reference measured #010101 in this role.

secondary.role: Highlight words in headings, primary pills, icons, focus rings. Reference uses #25e2cc / #7ceee0 in this role.

neutral.usage: #eefbd2 lime-tinted white for headings (reference #d3f9f5 mint-white); #ffffff card titles/nav; #c3cdd8 body (10:1); #9aabbd muted (7.2:1); #0a2740 rounded panels/cards (reference #1c1e24); #001224 deep bands.

color.contrast_strategy: Dark navy canvas throughout; contrast by lime highlight words and lime pills; white footer closes the page

typography.font_style_notes: Single geometric sans. Uppercase gradient hero; sentence-case section headings where one phrase is coloured lime.

spacing.section_rhythm: 72/96/120px section padding by breakpoint; 1440px max container

layout.alignment_tendency: Hero left; case studies, process and closing CTA centred; services/insights heading-left + pill-right

shape.border_usage: 1px lime (38% alpha) card outlines; 1px white outline pills; hairline row separators

elevation.depth_cues: Blurred lime/teal radial glows behind sections; backdrop-blurred floating header

motion.entrance_pattern: Fade-up 30px on scroll into view, staggered 80–120ms

components.button_style: Primary: lime pill, navy text, ↳ icon. Secondary: white-outline pill filling lime on hover. Tertiary: solid white pill.
components.input_style: Underline-only fields; lime focus line; uppercase muted labels
components.card_style: Tall 20px-radius cards, lime hairline border, navy vertical gradient, number top-left, line icon + title + copy at bottom
components.navigation_pattern: Floating navy bar with 40px rounded bottom corners, centred links, lime Let's Talk pill; full-screen navy sheet on mobile
components.list_style: Article rows separated by hairlines inside a rounded surface panel
components.component_notes: Live clock pill in hero; white footer with uppercase column headings, clock chip, mint 'Back to top' pill

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A glowing product stage at night

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous dark space; content floats on glows
visual_language.focal_strategy: one coloured phrase per heading + one glossy 3D object
visual_language.texture_usage: Soft radial glows, glossy 3D, photography in rounded cards

imagery.photo_treatment: Full colour inside 28–40px rounded cards with bottom navy gradient for captions
imagery.graphic_elements: Glows, oversized gradient wordmark, line icons

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Pills fill lime, cards' border turns solid lime with glow, images zoom 1.04
interaction_feel.loading_style: Navy loader with logo, lime progress bar, counter

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: ↳ + short imperative (Let's Talk, Work with us, Start a project)

overview.fallback_strategy: No WebGL → monochrome cliff video; reduced motion → no wordmark drift, videos paused, instant fades

background_effects.description: Blurred lime and teal radial glows behind sections; monochrome looping videos in the culture card and inner-page heroes

particle_systems.description: White/lime dust drifting in the hero

3d_elements.description: Glossy black lacquer & chrome knot with lime rim and teal fill (stands in for SAI's glass prism), right side of hero

params.lighting: warm key, lime rim spot, teal fill, baked Lightformers

scroll_morphing.description: Header gains blur, shadow and lime hairline once scrolled

text_effects.description: Uppercase hero/page titles filled with a lime-tinted gradient; one lime phrase per section heading

image_effects.description: Slow zoom on hover inside rounded cards

visual_effects.composite_notes: Reference section order mapped to Dravintel content: hero → case studies carousel (work) → capability cards (services) → product band with giant wordmark (process) → partners (clients) → rounded insights panel (Substack posts) → culture split (video card) → closing CTA → white footer with clock chip. Reference's small section labels intentionally omitted per client preference.
